import Mathlib

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem mathd_numbertheory_728 : 29^13 - 5^13 ≡ 3 [ZMOD 7] := by
  have h1 : (29 : ℤ) ^ 13 % 7 = 1 := by
    norm_num [pow_succ, Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod]
    <;> rfl
  
  have h2 : (5 : ℤ) ^ 13 % 7 = 5 := by
    norm_num [pow_succ, Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod]
    <;> rfl
  
  have h3 : (29 : ℤ) ^ 13 - (5 : ℤ) ^ 13 ≡ 3 [ZMOD 7] := by
    have h4 : (29 : ℤ) ^ 13 % 7 = 1 := h1
    have h5 : (5 : ℤ) ^ 13 % 7 = 5 := h2
    have h6 : ((29 : ℤ) ^ 13 - (5 : ℤ) ^ 13) % 7 = 3 := by
      have h7 : ((29 : ℤ) ^ 13 - (5 : ℤ) ^ 13) % 7 = ((29 : ℤ) ^ 13 % 7 - (5 : ℤ) ^ 13 % 7) % 7 := by
        simp [Int.sub_emod]
      rw [h7]
      rw [h4, h5]
      norm_num
      <;> rfl
    
    have h8 : (29 : ℤ) ^ 13 - (5 : ℤ) ^ 13 ≡ 3 [ZMOD 7] := by
      rw [Int.ModEq]
      omega
    exact h8
  
  exact h3
